articles.title: Sam Altman outlines three possible futures for AI, calls compute monopoly ‘terrible’
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has outlined three possible futures for artificial intelligence, including an international watchdog modelled on the IAEA, a unified AI research organisation, and a scenario in which one company gains overwhelming computing power to eliminate competitors. According to The Latin Times, the discussion reflects growing concerns over AI safety, regulation and competition.
